title: Patriot Sportfishing
specs: Whale watching trips often see gray whales, humpback whales, killer whales, dolphins, sea otters, sea lions, pelicans, and seagulls
No age limit; children allowed if they weigh at least 45 pounds and have a responsible adult
Group reservations require guests to be in line consecutively to sign the manifest and make purchases
includes: Hot galley with food and drinks available for purchase
blurb: Guests can book fishing trips of various durations with an experienced crew and a hot galley offering food and drinks for purchase. Whale watching and nature cruises run December through March and last about 2 hours. Burial at sea services are also offered and last 2 hours.
extraNote: All reservations require 100% deposits · Ticket prices do not include rod rentals, tackle, or licenses; these are paid on the day of the trip · No credit card machines on the boat; purchases on the boat are cash only · Check in is one hour prior to departure time
